card.name: Last piece of a product name
card.fires_on: The final piece of a brand or dosage-form name, such as the end of INGREZZA SPRINKLE, Injection USP, or PANRETIN GEL. It is usually followed by a verb or a bracketed reference.

modes.label: Brand name endings
modes.description: Last piece of an upper-case brand name or its dosage form in label text.
modes.example: Concomitant use of strong CYP3A4 inducers with INGREZZA or INGREZZA SPRINK<<LE>> is not recommended

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: The form word such as tablets or system right after a drug name, before a comma.
modes.example: such as fentanyl transdermal<< system>>, but use in such patients necessitates

modes.label: Other noun endings
modes.description: Rare hits on everyday text, ending a noun phrase before a verb.
modes.example: best inform us about Native American history and<< heritage>> is no small task
